title: Mateo's Fireplace: 1 Hour of Crackling Fire + Slow-Breath Tones for Deep Sleep
description:
AI-generated fictional persona. Not affiliated with UNM.

One hour by Mateo's fireplace. A soft crackling fire with a warm low drone that swells and settles at six breaths a minute (4 seconds in, 6 seconds out), a pace often used to help the body downshift into rest. No talking, no music drops, no ads mid-way from us. The tones bow out in the last few minutes and the fire carries you the rest of the way.

All sound and picture made from scratch by Sandoval Studios. Goodnight.
